name: @gjsify/integration-deltachat
description: Integration tests: DeltaChat / chatmail core (@deltachat/jsonrpc-client + @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server) on Node + GJS. Validates that the pure-JS JSON-RPC client speaks to the Rust core process over stdio via @gjsify/child_process — the canonical real-world consumer for a future native Adwaita+GJS DeltaChat app.

scripts.build:test: gjsify run build:test:node && gjsify run build:test:gjs
scripts.test: gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:node && gjsify run test:gjs
